minutes_text:
ACTION MEMO
  PARKLANDS COMMITTEE
  FEBRUARY 9, 2015

Council Chambers  Monday
City Hall  February 9, 2015
340 Palos Verdes Drive West  7:30 p.m.
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

Actions taken by this Committee are advisory. The City Council will take action on
all appropriate items on Tuesday, February 24, 2015.

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL  Members present: Chair Peterson, Rubincam, Wade, Kaviani
  & Chooljian

  Members absent: None

COMMUNICATIONS FROM PUBLIC

None

CITIZEN APPLICATION

1.  PC-388-14; Application to remove 4 public trees located in the parkways adjacent
  to 941 and 944 Via Rincon

  Applicant:  David Lu
  949 Via Rincon
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

Action: Committee member Wade moved & Rubincam seconded to approve the
removal of 4 trees located in the parkway adjacent to 941, 944 and 945 Via Rincon
according to the ‘Standard Conditions for Tree Removals’ and understanding that
the applicant will bear all costs. Require $500 payment to the ‘Tree Bank’ for each
tree approved for removal. The vote was 5-0.
 Actions taken by this Committee are advisory. The City Council will take action on all
  appropriate items on Tuesday, February 24, 2015.

  Directors initials SR-L
 2.  PC-390-15; Application to remove 4 Canary Island pine trees located in the
  parkway adjacent to 2225 and 2221Via Cerritos

  Applicant:  Johnson Chang
  2228 Via Cerritos
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

Action: Committee member Rubincam moved & Wade seconded to approve the
removal of 4 Canary Island pine trees located in the parkway adjacent to 2221 and
2225 Via Cerritos according to the ‘Standard Conditions for Tree Removals’ and
understanding that the applicant will bear all costs. Require $500 payment to the
‘Tree Bank’ for each tree removed. Require that if tree removal occurs after March
15, 2015 that measures be taken to avoid interference with any nesting birds,
including use of a qualified arborist or biologist to conduct a bird survey and delay
of tree removal activities until nesting activity is complete or a determination that
nesting season has ended. The vote was 5-0.

3.  PC-391-15; Application to remove 1 pine tree in the parkway located adjacent to
  1612 Chelsea Road

  Applicant:  Rick Marshall
  #86 Rocking Horse Road
  Rancho Palos Verdes, CA 90275

Action: Committee member Kaviani moved & Chooljian seconded to approve the
removal of 1 Canary Island pine tree located in the parkway adjacent to 1612
Chelsea Road according to the ‘Standard Conditions for Tree Removals’ and
understanding that the applicant will bear all costs. Require $500 payment to the
‘Tree Bank’. The vote was 5-0.

OLD BUSINESS

4.  Discussion of Application Process for Proposed Changes within the Parklands.

Action: The Committee discussed the item, provided direction and continued the
discussion to the next meeting. The Parklands Committee approved in concept the
classification system of paths (as presented to City Council on 12/9/14), the 2-step
process for more complex projects, a 1-step process for “Scheduled Maintenance”
and “Minor Planting Plans” and an administrative process for routine maintenance
involving volunteer labor and materials. The Parklands Committee also expressed
interest in having a broader understanding of City-sponsored maintenance
activities/repairs. Staff was directed to prepare a draft application and fact sheet
explaining the process for discussion at the next meeting.
 Actions taken by this Committee are advisory. The City Council will take action on all
  appropriate items on Tuesday, February 24, 2015.

  Directors initials SR-L
 NEW BUSINESS

None
